news.title: Hallow’s End Brings Frights, Delights, and Haunting Rewards
news.summary: Hallow’s End celebrates the Forsaken's break from the Scourge. Fun and mischief reign as the Innkeepers of Azeroth dole out treats and tricks to those who partake in the festivities.

news.title: Unlock a Year of World of Warcraft®
news.summary: Claim a 12-Month Subscription or 365-Days Game Time and get bonus in-game cosmetic items, including several for use in World of Warcraft: Forever!

news.title: Midnight's 12.1.5 Content Update is Now Live
news.summary: Midnight’s 12.1.5 content update brings the Labyrinth of Kindo’jan—a massive nine-chamber Delve-like challenge, a new single-boss raid, Season 2's mid-season refresh, the dramatic conclusion to the saga of Quel’Thalas and Zul’Aman, Aqir Invasions, and more.

news.title: Owltastic Adventures Await
news.summary: Take flight with Whoofle Bramblewing, a bright-eyed owl mount eager to explore hidden wonders, untrodden paths, and distant horizons.

news.title: Carve a New Path with World of Warcraft: Forever
news.summary: Catch up on everything announced for World of Warcraft: Forever during BlizzCon, including a first look at the next chapter for Azeroth and the adventures waiting on the horizon.

news.title: Pre-Purchase World of Warcraft: Forever Upgrades
news.summary: Answer the call to a reimagined Azeroth with World of Warcraft: Forever. Pre-purchase the Skyborne Heroic Pack, Skyborne Epic Pack, or Warcraft Forever Collection on the Battle.net Shop to unlock upgrade benefits, prepare for beta, and bring a friend along with Invite-A-Friend Launch Codes when it goes live.

forever.launchLine: World of Warcraft: Forever launches on November 4, 2026.
forever.betaLine: Forever Beta begins on September 17, 2026, and is available through October 21, 2026.
forever.namesLine: Early Name Reservation will be available starting October 27 through November 3.
forever.collectionLine: Warcraft Forever Collection will be available through January 11, 2027.
forever.heroLine: World of Warcraft: Forever is coming November 4!

events.title: World of Warcraft Live Q&A
events.desc: Live Q&A with the WoW development team on BlizzCon 2026 reveals, 10:00 a.m. PDT on the official Warcraft Twitch and YouTube channels.
